steps.label: NVIDIA driver
steps.sub: kernel module — lets the OS/hardware talk to the physical GPU

steps.label: CUDA Toolkit
steps.sub: user-space compiler + runtime that frameworks link against

steps.label: NVIDIA Container Toolkit
steps.sub: lets a container reach through to the host's GPU at all

code:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y nvidia-driver-550
sudo reboot

# after reboot
nvidia-smi
# look for the CUDA Version field — the MAX the driver supports,
# not necessarily what's installed
caption: A working driver prints the GPU model, driver version, and max CUDA version.

code:
sudo apt-get install -y nvidia-container-toolkit
sudo nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=docker
sudo systemctl restart docker

docker run --rm --gpus all \
  nvidia/cuda:12.4.1-base-ubuntu22.04 nvidia-smi
caption: nvidia-ctk registers the GPU runtime hook with Docker — skip it and --gpus all fails.
